notes: Adds an optional cPanel IP Blocker integration to Gateway Settings: when configured with a cPanel API token, every auto-block (daily volume, oversized payload, or the new per-minute flood guard) is also registered with cPanel's own IP Blocker, so the IP gets rejected by the web server itself instead of ever reaching PHP - this is what actually prevents a flood from exhausting the hosting account's entry-process limit (the real cause of the 503 outage). Off by default; set it up under Free Service Gateway > Settings. No database update needed for this update.
